Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add comprehensive CLI for all PHEV controls

Implements command-line interface for all MQTT control functions:

Climate Control \(cmd/climate.go\):
- Immediate start/stop \(heat/cool/windscreen with duration\)
- Timer management \(set, clear, list for 5 timers\)
- MY2014/2015 and MY2018+ model support

Lights Control \(cmd/lights.go\):
- Parking lights on/off
- Headlights on/off

Charging Control \(cmd/charging.go\):
- Cancel charge timer command

Vehicle Status \(cmd/status.go\):
- Complete status display with formatted output
- Shows battery, charging, doors, lights, climate state

Documentation:
- CLI_GUIDE.md: Complete reference with examples
- CLIMATE_CLI.md: Detailed climate control guide with MQTT equivalents

All commands include:
- Help text and examples
- Global flags \(--address, -v, -t, -s\)
- Input validation
- Proper error handling

Examples:
  phev2mqtt client climate start heat 20
  phev2mqtt client lights parking on
  phev2mqtt client charging cancel-timer
  phev2mqtt client status

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
